description.label: Description
description.value:
Novice: Your mind and body are one with the heavens. Legend says those who follow this Path are blessed with great fortune and the ability to strike with the speed of lightning. Your Unarmed attacks now have the Fast Weapon Quality.

Apprentice: You gain the Bless (Celestial Dragon Emperor) Talent.

Journeyman: You gain the +1 Riposte Talent when using

Unarmed attacks.

Master: You now regain one Fortune point after you successfully defeat a Size (Medium) or larger enemy with full health in one hit.
